title: Drop-Off
description: Avoid obstacles, slam down, collect coins, and survive the endless fall!
controls: Keyboard: A/D or Left/Right Arrow keys to move left/right. Spacebar to slam. Mouse/Touch: Tap or click the left/right side of the screen to move, and use the orange SLAM button to crash down.

title: The Button
description: Press the red button, obey chaotic factory commands, survive trapdoors, and blow up the enemy base!
controls: Mouse/Touch: Tap or click the giant red button according to the LCD display instructions. Obey color matches, countdowns, and trap warnings!

title: Maze
description: Navigate a retro 3D voxel labyrinth! Find checkpoints, climb ladders, avoid deadly hazards, and conquer the maze.
controls: WASD / Arrow Keys: Move | Mouse: Look around (Click to lock cursor, Esc to unlock) | Space: Jump. On Touch: Virtual joystick & jump button.
